learn.title: Letters for unknown numbers
learn.body: A variable is a letter, like $n$ or $x$, that stands for a number that can change or is not known yet. An expression is a mix of numbers, variables and operations, like $3n+5$. An expression has no equals sign.

learn.title: Parts of an expression
learn.body: In $3n+5$ there are two terms, $3n$ and $5$, separated by the plus sign. The number multiplying the variable (3) is the coefficient. A term with no variable (5) is a constant. We write $3n$ instead of $3\times n$.

learn.title: Words into symbols
learn.body: "5 more than $n$" is $n+5$. "3 less than $x$" is $x-3$, with the order reversed. "Twice a number" is $2n$. "The quotient of $y$ and 4" is $\frac{y}{4}$. Look for words like sum, difference, product and quotient.

learn.title: Write an expression
learn.body: Pens cost $p$ dollars each. You buy 3 pens and a 2 dollar notebook.
steps: If $p=1$ dollar, the total is $3+2=5$ dollars.

learn.body: "Less than" flips the order. "3 less than $x$" is $x-3$, not $3-x$.

questions.explanation: "More than" means add. $n+5$ is $n$ with 5 added.

questions.prompt: In $3n+5$, what is the coefficient of $n$?
questions.explanation: The coefficient is the number multiplying the variable.
Twice means two times, so $2\times n=2n$. $n^2$ would mean $n\times n$.

questions.prompt: Which is a constant term in $4x+7$?
questions.explanation: A constant has no variable. 4 is the coefficient and $4x$ is the variable term.

questions.prompt: Match each phrase with its expression.
questions.explanation: Sum means add, product means multiply, divided by means a fraction bar.

questions.prompt: Write the cost of 3 pens at $p$ dollars each plus a 2 dollar notebook.
questions.explanation: Build the expression one piece at a time, then join the parts.
